notes.subject: ⟨daminɛ ye⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew is a bare construct 'beginning-of wisdom'; Bambara requires the copula ye … ye.

notes.subject: קנה / קנינך
notes.rationale: Same root qanah in verb and noun: 'get … with all your getting' — root echo preserved by repeating ta.

notes.subject: ראשית חכמה
notes.rationale: Read as a nominal clause ('the beginning of wisdom is — get wisdom') or as an elliptical exclamation ('the first thing is wisdom'); rendered as a statement with imperative.

translation: Hakili ye ⟨daminɛ ye⟩: hakili ta, ani i ta fɛnw bɛɛ la, dɔnni ta.
